📺 Ginny & Georgia (2021–Present)

Ginny & Georgia follows Georgia Miller, a charming and fiercely protective single mother who moves to the picturesque town of Wellsbury, Massachusetts, with her teenage daughter Ginny and younger son Austin, hoping to give her family a fresh start. While Georgia works to build a better future and leave her troubled past behind, Ginny struggles with the challenges of growing up, navigating friendships, romantic relationships, school drama, and discovering her own identity. Despite their close bond, the mother and daughter frequently clash as Ginny begins questioning Georgia’s mysterious history and unconventional decisions. As secrets from Georgia’s past threaten their new life, the family becomes caught in complicated relationships, unexpected betrayals, and emotional conflicts. Through moments of humor, heartbreak, romance, and suspense, the series explores motherhood, family loyalty, identity, mental health, friendship, and the complicated relationship between parents and children.

🎭 Genre: Comedy • Drama • Romance • Mystery

⭐ IMDb: 7.5/10

⏱️ Runtime: ~50–60 minutes per episode • Multiple seasons

🎥 Creator: Sarah Lampert

🏆 Recognition: Starring Brianne Howey, Antonia Gentry, Diesel La Torraca, Felix Mallard, Sara Waisglass, and Jennifer Robertson, the series became one of Netflix’s popular coming-of-age dramas. Praised for its emotional performances, complicated family relationships, and unexpected plot twists, it gained a large international following and sparked conversations about motherhood, teenage struggles, identity, and generational trauma.

📺 Where to Watch: Netflix. Availability varies by region.

source_details.synopsis: Ginny & Georgia is an American comedy-drama television series created by Sarah Lampert. The series follows the life of thirty‐one‐year‐old Georgia Miller (portrayed by Brianne Howey) and her teenage children, Ginny (Antonia Gentry) and Austin (Diesel La Torraca), as they relocate to the fictional town of Wellsbury, Massachusetts. The series blends elements of teen drama, family dynamics, mystery, and darker themes. The first season of Ginny & Georgia premiered on Netflix on February 24, 2021, with a second and third season following in January 2023 and June 2025, respectively.
